statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ x : ℕ, B<x ∧ modes 1 x false ≤ (19/50 : ℝ)*budget x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0052 · 在无界共同尺度把实际高频和压到 19/50
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0052 · Budget 19/50 for the actual high modes on unbounded scales

brief.zh: 研究同一 x 上两支指定有限范数的差。采用自守提升时还须控制与这两支测试的匹配误差。
brief.en: Estimate the difference of the two prescribed norms on one scale. An automorphic lift must also control the errors against these exact tests.
